title: Dadista · lo astral
description: Dadista's levels 4 to 7 (docs/animas/dadaista/): Maná +1 and a hand of four, Dados astrales (a rain of dice of light on foes at random, as many as the Crítico gives), Ases en dúo (everyone's Crítico twice for three rounds) and the meteor in its three sizes, Meteorito, Meteoro and Asteroide, each used on the turn after the one before. Gerard wears it at level 7 in the fight tester beside Aitor's Matemágico, against three sturdy dogs. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }));

ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ["mano", "ojo", "tijeras", "corchete"]; g.secondary = 4; g.racha = 5;  });

steps.caption: Level 4 gives Maná +1: a hand of four dice. Racha 5 on the plate
The skill list at level 7: Tirar dado, Agitar, Estrella fugaz, Dados astrales, Ases en dúo and Meteorito
Dados astrales is paid with one die, the one picked
Dados astrales: the die goes up as light and a rain of dice of light comes down on foes at random, one for each 15 % of Crítico, each with its own number; the Racha starts again
After the rain: the Racha is gone from the plate

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ["mano", "blanco", "corchete", "ojo"]; g.secondary = 4; g.racha = 2;  });

steps.caption: Ases en dúo costs two dice: the first is picked, the other is the one worth least
Ases en dúo: two dice turn to light, circle each other over the party and fall on both as a shower; everyone's Crítico counts twice for three rounds
While it lasts: Crítico up on both plates, with its rounds

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ["mano", "ojo", "tijeras", "corchete"]; g.secondary = 4; g.racha = 0; });

steps.caption: Meteorito: the die goes up and a rock of light the size of a die comes down on one foe
After it a larger rock stays turning over Gerard's head: used again on his next turn, it is Meteoro

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ["mano", "ojo", "tijeras", "corchete"]; g.secondary = 4; g.racha = 2; });

steps.caption: The same row now reads Meteoro, with its two dice
Meteoro: the rock overhead is the one that comes down, harder
A third rock, larger again, waits for the next turn

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ["mano", "ojo", "tijeras", "corchete"]; g.secondary = 4; g.racha = 2; });

steps.caption: Asteroide: three dice, on every foe
Asteroide: one rock for all of them, the fight stopped a quarter of a second as it lands
After the Asteroide the skill is Meteorito again
